query:
INSERT INTO photos(id,short_id,album_id,title,original_hash,original_name,original_bytes,mime,kind,gps_lat,gps_lon)
      SELECT id,short,$3,'Map cap',$4,'photo.jpeg',1,'image/jpeg','image',-80+mod(n,160),-170+mod(n,340)
      FROM unnest($1::uuid[],$2::text[]) WITH ORDINALITY AS t(id,short,n)
